wonder.does: Stand at a vantage point and look out.
wonder.line: It feels like the sky goes on further than you ever knew.

mirth.does: Play for a crowd, or make the folk laugh.
mirth.line: Laughter fizzes up through you, a shaken bottle whose cork was never going to hold.

desire.line: You lean toward it as a moth leans to a lamp, and having it only turns up the flame.

grief.does: Lose what you staked, or what you carried.
grief.line: There is a hollow in you the exact shape of what you lost, and nothing else will fit.

dread.line: Every shadow holds its breath at once, and so do you.

fury.does: Answer a blow with a blow.
fury.line: You steam and rattle like a kettle on the boil, and you have stopped wanting the lid on.

gall.line: Your stomach curdles like milk gone sour, and you roll up your sleeves anyway.
